title: SB472 (2018 Regular): Public Safety - Permit to Wear, Carry, or Transport a Handgun - Expiration and Renewal

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2018RS/bills/sb/sb0472f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader, as filed; no vote recorded. Initial term changes from 2 to 5 years, renewal from 3 to 5 years (bracketed old numbers dropped).

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–309): (a) Except as provided in subsection (d) of this section, a permit expires on the last day of the holder’s birth month following 5 years after the date the permit is issued. (b) Subject to subsection (c) of this section, a permit may be renewed for successive periods of 5 years each if, at the time of an application for renewal, the applicant possesses the qualifications for the issuance of a permit and pays the renewal fee stated in this subtitle.
